command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command $items = @(Get-Process -Name cockpit-tools -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($items.Count -gt 1) { throw 'Ambiguous cockpit process identity' }; $present=($items.Count -eq 1); if ($present) { $p=$items[0]; if ($p.Path -ne 'C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Cockpit Tools\cockpit-tools.exe') { throw 'Unexpected cockpit identity' } }; [ordered]@{ at=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); processId=$(if ($present) {$p.Id} else {$null}); executable='C:\Users\PC\AppData\Local\Cockpit Tools\cockpit-tools.exe'; observedRunningBefore=$present; userAuthorizedTemporaryClose=$true; restorationRequired=$true } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'quality/evidence/T30/cockpit-temporary-close22.json' -Encoding utf8NoBOM; if ($present) { $taskPid=$p.Id; Stop-Process -Id $taskPid -ErrorAction Stop; $p.WaitForExit(); if (Get-Process -Id $taskPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { throw 'Cockpit close not confirmed' }; Write-Output 'Authorized exact executable closed.' } else { Write-Output 'Cockpit absent before test; no close claimed; authorized restoration required.' }
